data.narrative:
Fergani Space is a private-stage space and aerospace company founded by Selçuk Bayraktar. The valuation universe comprises 13 comparable companies: 5 public peers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Standard triangulation methods are inapplicable here. Peer-median valuation cannot be calculated because the narrow filters—same stage, adjacent stage, and similar valuation tier—yielded fewer than three datapoints across the 14 same-sector peers identified. Public-comp anchoring using the Space & Aerospace sector P/S median of 26.4x is not feasible; the target's revenue is not on file, which is typical for private companies. Without either a sufficiently dense peer set at comparable maturity or disclosed financial metrics, traditional valuation frameworks cannot be reliably triangulated.

A credible valuation range cannot be supported by the available data. The analysis is constrained by two material gaps: the absence of revenue or EBITDA disclosure for the target, and the scarcity of private peers at identical or adjacent stage with public pricing. Key uncertainties include the company's current capital structure, revenue trajectory (if any), and capital intensity relative to peers. Further valuation work requires either disclosure of financial metrics or identification of more granularly comparable private financings.
